title: Kishilik va egalik olmoshlari
goal_uz: Dars oxirida I, me, my, mine kabi olmoshlarni to‘g‘ri tanlaysiz, he va she ni adashtirmaysiz, gapda egani tushirib qoldirmaysiz va ismlarni olmosh bilan almashtirib qisqa matnni qayta yoza olasiz.

scenes.title: Yigirma birinchi darsga xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Yigirma birinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. Oldingi darsda ko‘plikni va sanashni o‘rgandik: two books, how many. Bugun gapdagi kichik, lekin juda muhim so‘zlarni o‘rganamiz: olmoshlar. I, he, they, me, her, my, mine. Dars oxirida ismlarni olmosh bilan almashtirib, qisqa matnni to‘g‘ri va tabiiy yoza olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back! Last time we counted things. Today we learn small but powerful words: pronouns.
scenes.say_uz: Qaytganingizga xush kelibsiz! O‘tgan safar narsalarni sanadik. Bugun kichik, lekin kuchli so‘zlarni o‘rganamiz: olmoshlarni.

scenes.title: Kishilik olmoshlari: gap egasi
scenes.say_native: Birinchi guruh: gapning egasi bo‘ladigan olmoshlar. I — men, you — sen yoki siz, he — u, she — u, it — u, we — biz, they — ular. Ular fe’ldan oldin keladi: I am, she works, they live. Muhim tafsilot: “I” har doim bosh harf bilan yoziladi, gap o‘rtasida ham. Ismlarni takrorlamaslik uchun aynan shu olmoshlardan foydalanamiz.
scenes.say: I, you, he, she, it, we, they. I am a student. They are my friends.
scenes.say_uz: Men, sen yoki siz, u, u, u, biz, ular. Men talabaman. Ular mening do‘stlarim.

scenes.title: He, she, it: o‘zbekcha “u” uch xil

examples.t: My father is a doctor. He works here.
examples.uz: Dadam shifokor. U shu yerda ishlaydi.

examples.t: Where is my phone? It is here.

scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida erkak, ayol va narsa uchun bitta so‘z bor: “u”. Ingliz tilida esa uchta: he — erkak, she — ayol, it — narsa yoki hayvon. Shuning uchun gapirayotganda doim o‘ylashingiz kerak: kim haqida gapiryapman? Otam haqida bo‘lsa “he”, onam haqida “she”, telefon yoki stol haqida “it”. Odamga “it” deyish qo‘pol eshitiladi, narsaga esa “he” yoki “she” deyish g‘alati.
scenes.say: My father is a doctor. He works here. My mother is a teacher. She works at school. My phone is new. It is on the table.
scenes.say_uz: Dadam shifokor. U shu yerda ishlaydi. Onam o‘qituvchi. U maktabda ishlaydi. Telefonim yangi. U stol ustida.

scenes.title: He yoki she adashishi
board: ✗ My mother is a nurse. He works in a hospital.
✓ My mother is a nurse. She works in a hospital.
✗ Where is the key? He is on the table.
✓ Where is the key? It is on the table.
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida so‘zlashuvchilar eng ko‘p shu yerda adashadi. Gapda “u” deyishga o‘rganganimiz uchun “my mother … he” yoki “my father … she” deb yuboramiz. Tez gapirganda bu odatiy xato, lekin tinglovchi sizni boshqacha tushunishi mumkin. Narsalar uchun esa “it”: “Where is the key? It is on the table.” Har safar gap boshlashdan oldin kim yoki nima haqida gapirayotganingizni tekshiring.
scenes.say: My mother is a nurse. She works in a hospital. Where is the key? It is on the table.
scenes.say_uz: Onam hamshira. U kasalxonada ishlaydi. Kalit qani? U stol ustida.

scenes.title: Ismni olmosh bilan almashtiring
board: 1) Tom is my brother. ___ is tall.
2) Anna and I are friends. ___ are happy.
3) The book is new. ___ is good.
4) Mr and Mrs Lee are teachers. ___ work here.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap bor. Har birida bo‘sh joyga mos olmoshni ayting. Birinchi: Tom — mening akam, u baland bo‘yli. Ikkinchi: Anna va men do‘stmiz, biz xursandmiz. Uchinchi: kitob yangi, u yaxshi. To‘rtinchi: janob va xonim Li o‘qituvchilar, ular shu yerda ishlaydi. Olmoshni ayting.
scenes.say: Fill in the pronoun. Tom is my brother. Blank is tall. Anna and I are friends. Blank are happy.
scenes.say_uz: Olmoshni toping. Tom mening akam. U baland bo‘yli. Anna va men do‘stmiz. Biz xursandmiz.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi gapda Tom erkak, demak he. Ikkinchi gapda Anna va men, ya’ni ikki kishi, ikkalamiz, demak we. Uchinchi gapda kitob narsa, demak it. To‘rtinchi gapda janob va xonim Li, ikki kishi, demak they. Diqqat qiling: o‘zingiz ham ishtirok etsangiz “we”, boshqa bir nechta odam bo‘lsa “they”.
scenes.say: He is tall. We are happy. It is good. They work here.
scenes.say_uz: U baland bo‘yli. Biz xursandmiz. U yaxshi. Ular shu yerda ishlaydi.

scenes.title: Ingliz tilida olmoshni tushirib bo‘lmaydi
scenes.say_native: Bu o‘zbek va ingliz tillari orasidagi eng katta farqlardan biri. O‘zbekchada fe’lning oxirgi qo‘shimchasi kim ekanini aytadi: “talabaman”, “boraman”, shuning uchun “men” kerak emas. Ingliz tilida fe’l shaxsni ko‘rsatmaydi, shuning uchun gapda ega bo‘lishi shart. “I am a student”. “Sovuq” desangiz ham, ingliz tilida “It is cold” deyiladi. Bu “it” hech nimani bildirmaydi, shunchaki gap egasi o‘rnida turadi.
scenes.say: I am a student. I live in Tashkent. It is cold today. It is five o'clock.
scenes.say_uz: Men talabaman. Men Toshkentda yashayman. Bugun sovuq. Soat besh.

scenes.title: Egasiz gap
board: ✗ Am a student. / Live in Tashkent.
✓ I am a student. / I live in Tashkent.
✗ Is cold today. / Is five o'clock.
✓ It is cold today. / It is five o'clock.
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilidan o‘tgan odatlar tufayli “Am a student”, “Live in Tashkent”, “Is cold” kabi gaplar chiqib qoladi. Ingliz tilida bunday gap to‘liq emas. Har bir darak gapda ega bo‘lishi kerak: I, you, he, she, it, we yoki they. Ob-havo, vaqt va masofa haqida gapirganda ham “it” kerak: “It is cold”, “It is five o’clock”.
scenes.say: I am a student. I live in Tashkent. It is cold today. It is five o'clock.
scenes.say_uz: Men talabaman. Men Toshkentda yashayman. Bugun sovuq. Soat besh.

scenes.title: Olmosh qachon tushib qolishi mumkin
board: Anna is a nurse and works here.
Thanks! / Sounds good. / Hope you're well.
Are you tired? Yes, I am.

examples.t: Anna is a nurse and works here.
examples.uz: Anna hamshira va shu yerda ishlaydi.

scenes.say_native: Ba’zan olmosh tushib qolishi mumkin va bu tabiiy. Birinchi: “and” bilan bog‘langan ikkinchi qismda ega bir xil bo‘lsa, takrorlamaymiz. “Anna is a nurse and works here”. Ikkinchi: buyruq gaplarda “you” aytilmaydi. “Open the door, please”. Uchinchi: do‘stlar orasida qisqa iboralar: “Thanks!”, “Sounds good”. Lekin oddiy gapda ega tushmaydi, buni xotirangizdan chiqarmang.
scenes.say: Anna is a nurse and works here. Open the door, please. Thanks! Sounds good.
scenes.say_uz: Anna hamshira va shu yerda ishlaydi. Eshikni oching, iltimos. Rahmat! Yaxshi eshitiladi.

scenes.title: Qaysi gap to‘g‘ri?
board: 2) Tom is tired and goes home.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gapni tekshiring. Birinchi: Am from Samarkand. Ikkinchi: Tom is tired and goes home. Uchinchi: Is very hot today. To‘rtinchi: Close the window, please. Qaysi biri to‘g‘ri va qaysi birida olmosh yetishmaydi? Xatoni toping va to‘g‘rilab ayting.
scenes.say: Which are correct? Am from Samarkand. Tom is tired and goes home. Is very hot today. Close the window, please.
scenes.say_uz: Qaysilari to‘g‘ri? Samarqanddanman. Tom charchagan va uyga ketadi. Juda issiq. Derazani yoping.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi gap xato, to‘g‘risi: “I am from Samarkand”. Ikkinchi gap to‘g‘ri, chunki “and” dan keyin ega bir xil va uni takrorlash shart emas. Uchinchi xato, to‘g‘risi: “It is very hot today”. To‘rtinchi to‘g‘ri, chunki bu buyruq gap va “you” aytilmaydi.
scenes.say: I am from Samarkand. Tom is tired and goes home. It is very hot today. Close the window, please.
scenes.say_uz: Men Samarqanddanman. Tom charchagan va uyga ketadi. Bugun juda issiq. Derazani yoping, iltimos.

scenes.title: Qaratqich-tushum olmoshlari
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi guruh: fe’ldan keyin keladigan olmoshlar, ya’ni harakat kimga yoki nimaga qaratilganini bildiradi. I — me, he — him, she — her, we — us, they — them. “You” va “it” o‘zgarmaydi. “She knows me”, “I love them”. O‘zbek tilida bunda qo‘shimchalar bor: meni, seni, uni, bizni, ularni. Ingliz tilida esa qo‘shimcha o‘rniga olmosh o‘zi o‘zgaradi va fe’ldan keyin turadi.
scenes.say: I know him. She knows me. We love them. He sees us. They like her.
scenes.say_uz: Men uni bilaman. U meni taniydi. Biz ularni yaxshi ko‘ramiz. U bizni ko‘radi. Ular uni yoqtiradi.

scenes.title: Predloglardan keyin ham me, him, them
board: with me, with him, with us
for you, for her, for them
scenes.say_native: Predloglardan keyin ham tushum shakli ishlatiladi: with me, for her, to them, about us. O‘zbek tilida bu joyda qo‘shimchalar va ko‘makchilar bor: “men bilan”, “u uchun”, “bizga”. Ingliz tilida esa predlog, keyin “me”, “him” yoki “them”. “I” bunda kelmaydi. Shu sababli “with I” yoki “for she” deyish xato. Predlogdan keyin faqat me, you, him, her, it, us, them.
scenes.say: Come with us. This gift is for you. Give it to me. Talk to him.
scenes.say_uz: Biz bilan keling. Bu sovg‘a siz uchun. Uni menga bering. U bilan gaplashing.

scenes.title: I like she emas
board: ✗ I like she. / I see he.
✓ I like her. / I see him.
✗ This is for I. / with we
✓ This is for me. / with us
scenes.say_native: Ikki yo‘nalishda xato bo‘ladi. Birinchisi: fe’l yoki predlogdan keyin ega olmoshini qo‘yish, “I like she”, “for I”, “with we”. To‘g‘risi “I like her”, “for me”, “with us”. Ikkinchisi teskarisi: gap boshida tushum olmoshini qo‘yish, “Me am a student”. Gapning egasi bo‘lsa I, he, she, we, they. Harakat yo‘naltirilgan tomon bo‘lsa me, him, her, us, them.
scenes.say: I like her. I see him. This is for me. Come with us. I am a student.
scenes.say_uz: Men uni yoqtiraman. Men uni ko‘raman. Bu men uchun. Biz bilan keling. Men talabaman.

scenes.title: Ega yoki tushum?
scenes.say_native: Beshta gap bor, har birida to‘g‘ri shaklni tanlang: ega olmoshimi yoki tushum olmoshimi. Birinchi: I like she yoki her very much. Ikkinchi: Can you help I yoki me. Uchinchi: We yoki us live here. To‘rtinchi: give the book to he yoki him. Beshinchi: this is for they yoki them.
scenes.say: Choose. I like she or her very much. Can you help I or me? We or us live here. Give the book to he or him. This is for they or them.
scenes.say_uz: Tanlang. Men uni juda yoqtiraman. Menga yordam bera olasizmi? Biz shu yerda yashaymiz. Kitobni unga bering. Bu ular uchun.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: I like her, chunki fe’ldan keyin turibdi. Ikkinchi: Can you help me. Uchinchi: We live here, chunki “we” gapning egasi. To‘rtinchi: give the book to him, predlogdan keyin. Beshinchi: this is for them. Ko‘rdingizmi, gapning boshida ega, fe’l va predlogdan keyin esa tushum shakli.
scenes.say: I like her. Can you help me? We live here. Give the book to him. This is for them.
scenes.say_uz: Men uni yoqtiraman. Menga yordam bera olasizmi? Biz shu yerda yashaymiz. Kitobni unga bering. Bu ular uchun.

scenes.title: Egalik sifatlari: my, your, his...
scenes.say_native: Endi egalik. Narsa kimniki ekanini aytish uchun egalik sifatlari bor: my — mening, your — sening yoki sizning, his — uning (erkak), her — uning (ayol), its — uning (narsa), our — bizning, their — ularning. O‘zbek tilida bu ma’no ot oxiridagi qo‘shimcha bilan beriladi: kitobim, kitobing, kitobi. Ingliz tilida esa alohida so‘z ot oldidan turadi: my book, your book, his book. Qo‘shimcha ot oxiriga yopishmaydi.
scenes.say: My book. Your bag. His car. Her phone. Our house. Their children.
scenes.say_uz: Mening kitobim. Sizning sumkangiz. Uning mashinasi. Uning telefoni. Bizning uyimiz. Ularning bolalari.

scenes.title: His va her: egaga qarab
board: Egalik egasiga mos, ot soniga emas
scenes.say_native: Eng muhim qoida: egalik sifati narsaga emas, egasiga moslashadi. Tom bo‘lsa “his mother”, Anna bo‘lsa “her mother”, ikkalasi bo‘lsa “their mother”. Ona qanday jinsda bo‘lsa ham farqi yo‘q, egasi muhim. Otning soni o‘zgarsa ham egalik sifati o‘zgarmaydi: “her brother”, “her brothers”. O‘zbek tilida “uning” bitta, shu sabab his va her ni adashtirish tabiiy, lekin uni mashq bilan to‘g‘rilash mumkin.
scenes.say: Tom loves his sister. Anna loves her brothers. Tom and Anna love their mother.
scenes.say_uz: Tom singlisini yaxshi ko‘radi. Anna akalarini yaxshi ko‘radi. Tom va Anna onasini yaxshi ko‘rishadi.

scenes.title: Egalik sifati bilan xatolar
board: ✗ the my book / a my friend
✗ Tom loves her mother. (Tom o‘z onasini)
✗ my books are new. → ✓ My books are new.
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi: egalik sifati bilan artikl ishlatish. “The my book” yoki “a my friend” emas, faqat “my book”, “my friend”. Ikkinchisi: his va her ni adashtirish. Erkak o‘z onasi haqida “his mother” deydi, “her” deb emas. Uchinchisi: ko‘plik otga ham egalik sifati o‘zgarmasdan keladi, “my books”, “myes books” emas. Artikl yo‘q, o‘zgarish yo‘q: egalik sifati + ot.
scenes.say: My book. My friend. Tom loves his mother. My books are new.
scenes.say_uz: Mening kitobim. Mening do‘stim. Tom onasini yaxshi ko‘radi. Mening kitoblarim yangi.

scenes.title: Tom's — his, Anna's — her
board: Tom and Anna's house = their house
scenes.say_native: Matnda ismni olmosh bilan almashtirganda sizga yana bir narsa kerak bo‘ladi. Ismga “’s” qo‘shilsa, egalik bo‘ladi: Tom’s book, Anna’s bag. Bu o‘zbekchadagi “Tomning kitobi” ga to‘g‘ri keladi. Olmosh bilan almashtirsak: Tom’s book — his book, Anna’s bag — her bag. Bu shaklni keyingi darslarda chuqurroq o‘rganamiz, hozir faqat bilib qo‘ying, chunki uyga vazifada kerak bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Tom's book is his book. Anna's brother is her brother. Tom and Anna's house is their house.
scenes.say_uz: Tomning kitobi uning kitobi. Annaning akasi uning akasi. Tom va Annaning uyi ularning uyi.

scenes.title: Egalik sifatini tanlang
scenes.say_native: Beshta gapda egalik sifatini toping. Birinchi: Ali loves blank mother. Ikkinchi: Laila has blank keys. Uchinchi: we like blank teacher. To‘rtinchi: the cat likes blank food. Beshinchi: Ali and Laila love blank children. Kimniki ekanini aniqlab, mos so‘zni ayting.
scenes.say: Fill in. Ali loves blank mother. Laila has blank keys. We like blank teacher. The cat likes blank food. Ali and Laila love blank children.
scenes.say_uz: To‘ldiring. Ali onasini yaxshi ko‘radi. Laylaning kalitlari bor. Biz o‘qituvchimizni yoqtiramiz. Mushuk o‘z ovqatini yaxshi ko‘radi. Ali va Layla bolalarini yaxshi ko‘rishadi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Ali erkak, demak his mother. Layla ayol, demak her keys. Biz o‘zimiz haqimizda, demak our teacher. Mushuk narsa yoki hayvon, demak its food. Ali va Layla ikkita odam, demak their children. “Its” da apostrof yo‘q, buni yodda tuting, birozdan keyin sababini aytib beraman.
scenes.say: His mother. Her keys. Our teacher. Its food. Their children.
scenes.say_uz: Uning onasi. Uning kalitlari. Bizning o‘qituvchimiz. Uning ovqati. Ularning bolalari.

scenes.title: Egalik olmoshlari: mine, yours...
scenes.say_native: Egalik sifatidan keyin ot kerak: my book. Ot tushib qolsa, egalik olmoshi ishlatiladi: mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs. “This book is mine”, “Is this bag yours?”. O‘zbek tilida “meniki”, “seniki”, “uniki” deymiz, mana shu ma’no. Ikkita qoida: egalik olmoshidan keyin ot kelmaydi, va oxirida “s” bor, lekin his o‘zgarmaydi. Masalan: “my phone” — “mine”, “her phone” — “hers”.
scenes.say: This book is mine. That bag is yours. This phone is hers. These keys are ours.
scenes.say_uz: Bu kitob meniki. U sumka sizniki. Bu telefon uniki. Bu kalitlar bizniki.

scenes.title: Mine book, yours name
board: ✓ This is my book. / This book is mine.
scenes.say_native: Ikki sifat bilan olmoshni adashtirish juda keng tarqalgan. “Mine book” yoki “yours name” emas, chunki ot bor joyda egalik sifati kerak: my book, your name. Ot yo‘q joyda egalik olmoshi: “This book is mine”. Teskarisi ham xato: “This bag is my” deb gapni tugatib bo‘lmaydi, chunki “my” dan keyin ot kutiladi. Eslab qolish oson: ot bor, my; ot yo‘q, mine.
scenes.say: This is my book. This book is mine. Your name, please. This bag is mine.
scenes.say_uz: Bu mening kitobim. Bu kitob meniki. Ismingiz, iltimos. Bu sumka meniki.

scenes.title: You: sen ham, siz ham
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida “sen” va “siz” bor: do‘stga sen, katta odamga siz deymiz. Ingliz tilida esa bitta so‘z: “you”. U do‘stga ham, o‘qituvchiga ham, bir kishiga ham, bir necha kishiga ham ishlatiladi. “Are you ready, Anna?” va “Are you ready, Mr Brown?” gapida “you” bir xil. Sen-siz farqi boshqa vositalar bilan bildiriladi.
scenes.say: You are my friend. You are my teacher. You are all very kind.
scenes.say_uz: Siz mening do‘stimsiz. Siz mening o‘qituvchimsiz. Hammangiz juda mehribonsiz.

scenes.title: Hurmatni qanday bildiramiz
board: Mr Brown, Ms Green, Mrs Smith

examples.t: Excuse me, sir, could you help me?
examples.uz: Kechirasiz, janob, menga yordam bera olasizmi?

scenes.say_native: Hurmat so‘z shakli bilan emas, qo‘shimcha so‘zlar bilan bildiriladi. Birinchi: murojaat. Mr Brown, Ms Green, Mrs Smith; Mr, Ms yoki Mrs dan keyin odatda familiya keladi. Notanish odamga “sir” yoki “madam” deyish mumkin. Ikkinchi: muloyim so‘rov. “Give me the pen” emas, “Could you give me the pen, please?”. Uchinchi: “Would you like tea?”. Mana shu iboralar o‘zbekchadagi “siz” ning ingliz tilidagi o‘rnini bosadi.
scenes.say: Excuse me, sir, could you help me, please? Would you like some tea, Mrs Smith?
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz, janob, menga yordam bera olasizmi, iltimos? Choy ichasizmi, missis Smit?

scenes.title: Muloyim qiling
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapni muloyim qilib ayting. Birinchi: Give me the key, ya’ni kalitni bering, buni “could you” bilan aytib ko‘ring. Ikkinchi: o‘qituvchiga “Teacher, open the door”, buni “Excuse me, Mr Brown” bilan boshlang. Uchinchi: dadamga choy ichasizmi deb muloyim so‘rang. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Make it polite. Give me the key. Teacher, open the door! Dad, you want tea?
scenes.say_uz: Muloyim qiling. Kalitni bering. O‘qituvchi, eshikni oching! Dada, choy xohlaysizmi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: Could you give me the key, please?
Excuse me, Mr Brown, could you open the door, please?
Would you like some tea, Dad?
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “Could you give me the key, please?”. Ikkinchi: “Excuse me, Mr Brown, could you open the door, please?”. Uchinchi: “Would you like some tea, Dad?”. Esda tuting: ingliz tilida faqat “Teacher!” deb chaqirish g‘alati eshitiladi, ism yoki “Excuse me” yaxshiroq.
scenes.say: Could you give me the key, please? Excuse me, Mr Brown, could you open the door, please? Would you like some tea?
scenes.say_uz: Kalitni bera olasizmi, iltimos? Kechirasiz, janob Braun, eshikni ocha olasizmi, iltimos? Choy ichasizmi?

scenes.title: Talaffuz: her, him, them zaif shaklda
scenes.say_native: Tabiiy nutqda olmoshlar kuchsiz aytiladi. “Her” ko‘pincha “er” kabi, “him” “im” kabi, “them” esa “thum” kabi eshitiladi. Boshidagi h tovushi tushib qoladi: “give him” — “giv im”. Sababi shuki, olmosh muhim ma’no tashimaydi, ma’noli so‘z fe’l. Shuning uchun ularni juda kuchli aytmang. Ta’kidlaganda esa to‘liq o‘qiladi.
scenes.say: I like her. Give him the book. Tell them the news. I see you.
scenes.say_uz: Men uni yoqtiraman. Kitobni unga bering. Yangilikni ularga ayting. Men sizni ko‘raman.

scenes.title: Takrorlang
scenes.say_native: Endi takrorlang. Olmosh so‘zlar kuchsiz va qisqa bo‘lsin, fe’l esa aniq va biroz kuchliroq. I LIKE her. Give him THE BOOK, bunda him yengil, kitob esa aniq. TELL them. Fe’lni kuchliroq, olmoshni yengilroq ayting. Shoshilmasdan, lekin ravon takrorlang. Har qatorni ikki marta ayting.
scenes.say: I like her. Give him the book. Tell them. Are you OK?
scenes.say_uz: Men uni yoqtiraman. Kitobni unga bering. Ularga ayting. Yaxshimisiz?

scenes.title: Bir xil eshitiladigan so‘zlar

examples.t: It's my bag. Its colour is red.
examples.uz: Bu mening sumkam. Uning rangi qizil.

scenes.say_native: Uchta juft yoki guruh bir xil o‘qiladi, lekin turlicha yoziladi. Your va you’re: birinchisi egalik, ikkinchisi “you are”. Its va it’s: birinchisi egalik, apostrofsiz; ikkinchisi “it is”. Their va they’re: birinchisi egalik, ikkinchisi “they are”. Britaniya ingliz tilida “their” va “there” ham bir xil o‘qiladi. Shubha bo‘lsa, apostrofli shaklni “is” yoki “are” bilan almashtirib ko‘ring: mazmunli bo‘lsa, apostrof kerak.
scenes.say: Your bag. You're late. Its colour. It's red. Their house. They're here.
scenes.say_uz: Sizning sumkangiz. Siz kechikdingiz. Uning rangi. U qizil. Ularning uyi. Ular shu yerda.

scenes.title: Your yoki you're, its yoki it's
board: ✗ It's colour is red. → ✓ Its colour is red.
scenes.say_native: “Your late” emas, “You’re late”, chunki “you are late” degan ma’no. “It’s colour is red” emas, “Its colour is red”: bu egalik, apostrof kerak emas. “Their happy” emas, “They’re happy”. Qoida: apostrof faqat “is” yoki “are” ni bildiradi. Egalik sifatlarida hech qachon apostrof bo‘lmaydi.
scenes.say: You're late. Its colour is red. They're happy. Their house is big.
scenes.say_uz: Siz kechikdingiz. Uning rangi qizil. Ular xursand. Ularning uyi katta.

scenes.title: Tinglang: yo‘qolgan telefon
board: A: Excuse me, is this your phone?
B: No, it isn't mine. I think it's hers.
A: Excuse me, madam, is this phone yours?
C: Yes, it's mine! Thank you very much.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialogni tinglang. Bir erkak telefonni topib oldi. U yonidagi odamdan telefon uniki ekanini so‘raydi. U yo‘q deydi va telefon boshqa ayolniki bo‘lsa kerak deydi. Keyin erkak ayolga muloyim murojaat qiladi. Diqqat qiling: your, mine, hers, yours. Savollar: telefon birinchi odamnikimi? Aslida kimniki? Erkak ayolga qanday murojaat qildi?
scenes.say: Excuse me, is this your phone? No, it isn't mine. I think it's hers. Excuse me, madam, is this phone yours? Yes, it's mine! Thank you very much.
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz, bu sizning telefoningizmi? Yo‘q, u meniki emas. Menimcha, u uniki. Kechirasiz, xonim, bu telefon sizniki mi? Ha, u meniki! Katta rahmat.

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
board: 1) Does the second person own the phone?
3) How does the man speak to the woman?
scenes.say_native: Dialog bo‘yicha uchta savol. Birinchi: ikkinchi odam telefonning egasimi? Ikkinchi: telefon aslida kimniki? Uchinchi: erkak ayolga qanday murojaat qildi, qaysi so‘zni ishlatdi? Qisqa javoblar bering. Masalan, “Yes, it is” yoki “No, it isn’t” bilan boshlang.
scenes.say: Does the second person own the phone? Whose phone is it? How does the man speak to the woman?
scenes.say_uz: Ikkinchi odam telefon egasimi? Telefon kimniki? Erkak ayolga qanday murojaat qildi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) No, it isn't. It isn't his or hers.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: yo‘q, ikkinchi odam egasi emas, u “It isn’t mine” dedi. Ikkinchi: telefon ayolniki, ya’ni “hers”. Uchinchi: erkak “Excuse me, madam” dedi, bu juda muloyim murojaat. E’tibor bering, ayol oxirida “mine” dedi, chunki “phone” so‘zini takrorlash shart emas.
scenes.say: No, it isn't. It's hers. He says, Excuse me, madam.
scenes.say_uz: Yo‘q, u uniki emas. U ayolniki. U “Kechirasiz, xonim” dedi.

scenes.title: Tinglang: oilaviy surat
board: A: Who is that in the photo?
B: That's my sister, Aziza. She's a nurse.
B: They're my parents. Their house is in Samarkand. We visit them every summer.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Ikki do‘st oilaviy suratni ko‘rmoqda. Birinchisi suratdagi odamlar kimligini so‘raydi. Ikkinchisi singlisi Aziza haqida gapiradi. Keyin ota-onasi haqida gapiradi. Diqqat qiling: she, they, their, them. Savollar: Aziza kim? Uning kasbi nima? Ota-onasining uyi qayerda? Ular ota-onasinikiga qachon boradilar?
scenes.say: Who is that in the photo? That's my sister, Aziza. She's a nurse. And who are they? They're my parents. Their house is in Samarkand. We visit them every summer.
scenes.say_uz: Suratdagi kim? Bu mening singlim Aziza. U hamshira. Ular-chi, kimlar? Ular mening ota-onam. Ularning uyi Samarqandda. Biz ularni har yozda ziyorat qilamiz.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
scenes.say_native: Suratdagi dialog bo‘yicha to‘rtta savol. Aziza kim? Uning kasbi nima? Ota-onasining uyi qayerda? Ularni qachon ziyorat qilishadi? Javobda egalik sifatlarini ishlating: her, their. Masalan, “Her job is…”, ya’ni uning kasbi. Baland ovozda ayting, shoshilmang.
scenes.say: Who is Aziza? What is her job? Where is their house? When do they visit them?
scenes.say_uz: Aziza kim? Uning kasbi nima? Ularning uyi qayerda? Ularni qachon ziyorat qilishadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Aziza so‘zlovchining singlisi, “She is the speaker’s sister”. Uning kasbi hamshira, “She is a nurse”. Ota-onasining uyi Samarqandda, “Their house is in Samarkand”. Ularni har yozda ziyorat qilishadi, “every summer”. “Their house” egalik, “visit them” esa harakat qaratilgan tomon.
scenes.say: She is his sister. She is a nurse. Their house is in Samarkand. They visit them every summer.
scenes.say_uz: U uning singlisi. U hamshira. Ularning uyi Samarqandda. Ularni har yozda ziyorat qilishadi.

scenes.title: Matnni qayta yozing
board: Anna is a teacher. Anna lives in London.
Anna and Anna's husband like the city.
scenes.say_native: Endi sizning navbatingiz. Matnda ismlar juda ko‘p takrorlangan. Uni olmosh bilan o‘zgartiring. Anna is a teacher. Anna lives in London. Anna’s husband is a doctor. Anna and Anna’s husband like the city. Ikkinchi gapdan boshlab, Anna o‘rniga she yoki her va they, their ishlating. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Rewrite with pronouns. Anna is a teacher. Anna lives in London. Anna's husband is a doctor. Anna and her husband like the city.
scenes.say_uz: Olmosh bilan qayta yozing. Anna o‘qituvchi. Anna Londonda yashaydi. Annaning eri shifokor. Anna va eri shaharni yoqtirishadi.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: Anna is a teacher. She lives in London.
They like the city. Their life is busy.
scenes.say_native: Namuna. “Anna is a teacher. She lives in London. Her husband is a doctor. They like the city.” Ismni birinchi gapda aytdik, keyin she, her, they ishlatdik. O‘zbekcha o‘ylasangiz, “She lives”, “Her husband” aytish biroz ortiqcha tuyulishi mumkin, lekin ingliz tilida ega va egalik sifati shart.
scenes.say: Anna is a teacher. She lives in London. Her husband is a doctor. They like the city.
scenes.say_uz: Anna o‘qituvchi. U Londonda yashaydi. Uning eri shifokor. Ular shaharni yoqtirishadi.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
board: I, he, she, it, we, they + fe’l
my, your, his, her, its, our, their
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Birinchi: I, you, he, she, it, we, they gap egasi, uni tushirib bo‘lmaydi. Ikkinchi: me, him, her, us, them fe’l va predlogdan keyin keladi. Uchinchi: my, your, his, her, its, our, their ot oldida egasiga mos keladi. To‘rtinchi: mine, yours, hers, ours, theirs ot o‘rnini bosadi. Beshinchi: ingliz tilida bitta you bor, hurmat esa could, would, please va murojaat bilan bildiriladi.
scenes.say: Today: subject pronouns, object pronouns, possessive adjectives, possessive pronouns, and polite you.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun: ega olmoshlari, tushum olmoshlari, egalik sifatlari, egalik olmoshlari va muloyim you.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa: ismlar ko‘p takrorlangan 6–8 gaplik qisqa matn yozing va uni olmoshlar bilan qayta yozing. Mezon: kamida bitta ega olmoshi, bitta tushum olmoshi, bitta egalik sifati va bitta egalik olmoshi bo‘lsin, har bir gapda ega bo‘lsin, his va her adashmasin. Keyingi darsda joy predloglarini o‘rganamiz: in, on, under va boshqalar.
scenes.say: Homework: write a short text with repeated names, then rewrite it with pronouns. See you in the next lesson!
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifa: ismlari takrorlangan qisqa matn yozing va uni olmoshlar bilan qayta yozing. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz!

homework_uz: Ismlari ko‘p takrorlangan 6–8 gaplik qisqa matn yozing (masalan, oilangiz haqida) va uni olmoshlar bilan qayta yozing. Mezon: kamida bitta ega olmoshi (he, she, they), bitta tushum olmoshi (him, her, them), bitta egalik sifati (his, her, their) va bitta egalik olmoshi (mine, hers) bo‘lsin; har bir gapda ega bo‘lsin, his va her adashmasin. Matnni baland ovozda o‘qing. Keyingi darsda joy predloglarini o‘rganamiz.

quiz.why_uz: Ingliz tilida darak gapda ega (I) albatta bo‘lishi kerak.

quiz.q: My mother is a doctor. ___ works in a hospital.

quiz.why_uz: Egalik sifati egasiga mos: Tom erkak, shuning uchun his.
Ot yo‘q, shuning uchun egalik olmoshi yours.
You're = you are; your egalik sifati.

options: Could you give me the pen, please?
quiz.why_uz: Ingliz tilida hurmat could, please kabi iboralar bilan bildiriladi.

quiz.q: It's cold today. What does 'It' mean here?
quiz.why_uz: Ob-havo haqida gapirganda it ega vazifasini bajaradi.
